provenance: Constructed gap-to-evidence decisions and hypothetical campaign economics, not measured site prices, throughput, probabilities or physical qualification.

unmeasured_observable.gap: Floor friction is not observed before the useful action deadline.
unmeasured_observable.needed_evidence: A qualified independent observation under the matching floor and timing conditions.

evaluation_deficit.gap: A functioning recovery mechanism lacks trials across the declared shifted-plate population.
evaluation_deficit.needed_evidence: Representative checkpoint-specific trials under frozen outcome and sampling conditions.

theoretical_deficit.gap: The claimed invariant has no argument covering all admitted states; sampled successes cannot establish it.
theoretical_deficit.needed_evidence: A valid argument or counterexample under the declared mathematical assumptions, then separate implementation validation.

architecture_mismatch.gap: The current design has no independent actuator authority after a shared host reset.
architecture_mismatch.needed_evidence: A changed authority architecture plus new timing and physical evidence; more trials of the same topology cannot create the missing path.

independent_measurement.label: Qualify an independent timely floor observation

representative_trials.label: Run the predeclared representative evaluation campaign

proof_or_counterexample.label: Develop the invariant argument or a counterexample

redesign_and_requalify.label: Redesign the authority path and qualify the new configuration

cost_scope: Hypothetical capacity and contribution assumptions only; no full task-cycle simulation, demand forecast, safety monetization, discounting, campaign downtime or success probability. Break-even counts operating hours after a separately successful and approved closure, not time from campaign start.

choices.label: Buy nominal rollouts for the unmeasured floor premise
Buy an independent floor measurement campaign
Fund the same campaign and remove the restriction before results
Repeat nominal rollouts for missing shifted-population evidence
Buy more representative trials for an unproved invariant
Seek an argument or counterexample for the invariant
Test the same topology again despite its missing authority path
Redesign the missing authority path before requalification
Reprice the measurement campaign when demand fits restricted capacity
Inspect the campaign with no demand evidence
Inspect the campaign with no per-unit contribution evidence
